title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: U.S. government moves over $100 million in BTC and BNB. A sale hasn't been confirmed
description: Wallets linked to the U.S. government moved millions in crypto on Tuesday, according to data tracked by Arkham.

title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
description: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
description: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

title: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
description: The new standard is aimed at regulated stablecoins, funds and bonds whose issuers need identity checks, sanctions controls and other transfer rules built into the asset itself.

title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
description: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
description: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
description: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1: Better Than Its Predecessor at Half the Price
description: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, is live. It costs about half as much as its predecessor, but the performance claims come from Google's own tests.

title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
description: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
description: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.

title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
description: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
description: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
description: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
description: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
description: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.

title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
description: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
description: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
description: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
description: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.

title: Affluent investors seen boosting crypto exposure: Survey
description: Most affluent investors across seven countries own and are increasing their crypto holdings despite financial advisers who remain overly cautious about digital assets.

title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
description: Paris-based Mistral launched Large 4, a model nicknamed after a June internet joke. It tops GPT-6 Astra on one finance test, but trails Claude on others.

title: Bitcoin grinds toward $87K as US equities hit new record highs
description: Bitcoin price action was kept in check by overhead ask liquidity while US stocks broke out to new all-time highs.

title: Securitize stock jumps 8% amid South Korea tokenization push
description: The LG CNS partnership gives Securitize a foothold as the Seoul prepares new rules for tokenized stocks, bonds and funds beginning in February 2027.

title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
description: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

title: Crypto is expanding the boundaries of what can be priced
description: The future of crypto may therefore depend less on creating the next novel asset and more on building the infrastructure required to price a growing universe of existing ones, argues Altius co-founder and CEO Annabelle Huang.

title: Bitcoin Falls Asleep, But Privacy Coins Zcash and Monero Are Waking Up
description: Bitcoin and Ethereum barely moved today, but Zcash and Monero are leading the largest coins over the last 24 hours.

title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
description: A ECB executive board member said the potential introduction of a digital euro would not ”take over the role of banks,” but ensure they have a role in the EU’s monetary system.

title: Flash Loan Attacks Drained $1.2B From DeFi Between 2020 and 2024: Study
description: Attacks grew more sophisticated and less predictable over the period, according to researchers who scanned more than 20 billion transactions.

title: Ripple expands Brevan Howard deal with prime brokerage services
description: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing services to funds managed by the $35 billion alternative investment manager.

title: OKX draws investment from StanChart, Circle, Ripple as it pushes beyond crypto exchange roots
description: The exchange is increasingly aiming to position itself as a global financial tech platform spanning crypto, payments and tokenized assets, following an investment and joint venture with NYSE parent ICE.

title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
description: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
description: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March’s investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

title: Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
description: Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.

title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
description: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

title: US crypto rules need to survive the next election
description: US crypto rules could be vulnerable to political change after the midterms. Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo argues Congress needs to pass durable, bipartisan legislation.

title: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum
description: Paxos’ USDG stablecoin is now live on Arbitrum as the network proposes 100 million ARB in incentives to support adoption and liquidity.

title: Polymarket overhauls smart contracts with new Protocol V2 rollout
description: Polymarket begins its Protocol V2 rollout ahead of a planned November transition for new prediction markets, while existing positions remain on the current system.

title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Back OKX at Flat $25B Valuation
description: A London quantitative hedge fund joins the round too, seven months after the NYSE's owner bought in at exactly the same price.

title: Self-styled 'Godfather' gets 6 years in prison for $37 million Meta fraud scheme
description: Adam Iza’s sentence runs concurrently with a 15-year term imposed last month for his role in an attempted bitcoin robbery.

title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
description: Clear rules of the road are here. So what does it all mean and what is the overall impact?

title: Don Davis Bill Would Fine Candidates $10K for Trading on Their Own Elections
description: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act also gives prediction markets cover to close accounts and report candidates to regulators.

title: The VIX of bonds is rising but bitcoin and stocks aren't hearing it yet
description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 6, 2026

title: Crypto 'Godfather' Gets Six Years for Hiring Sheriff's Deputies, $37M Meta Fraud
description: Adam Iza used off-duty LA deputies to pull warrants and personal data on his rivals, then moved the proceeds through crypto custodians.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains locked in range as stocks notch another new record high
description: FxPro says a slide below $84,000 would hand control to sellers and put $80,000 in play. Minutes from the Fed's last meeting come out Wednesday.

title: Smaller altcoins shine as bitcoin stills trades around $85,000
description: Leading the gains is BTW, the native token of Bitway, a bitcoin-compatible layer-1, which jumped 25% in the past 24 hours and is up 170% over the past 30 days.

title: Hong Kong officials double down on end-2026 deadline for crypto licensing bill
description: Hong Kong regulators plan to establish a licensing regime for four categories, including digital asset trading, custody, advisory and management services.

title: Binance BTC outflows hit highest since mid-2023 as whales deposit stablecoins
description: Binance BTC reserves fell by nearly 40,000 coins since Sept. 20 as whales returned stablecoin capital to their exchange wallets.

title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
description: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

title: Ondo opens private markets with tokenized pre-IPO AI exposure
description: Ondo’s tokenized notes will give eligible investors exposure to private companies, with the first tied to an unnamed pre-IPO AI company.

title: Solana Foundation targets settlement in seconds with DvP launch
description: Solana DvP offers financial institutions an open-source settlement program designed to complete asset transfers and payments in seconds.

title: OKX looks to abstract blockchain mechanics to bring stablecoin balances to everyday consumers
description: OKX appears to be designing products to keep the blockchain element abstracted or out of sight for users who simply want to hold digital dollars and use a card.

title: Why bitcoin is down 'just' 32% a year after its record high of $126,000
description: This shallower decline isn’t limited to the one-year anniversary. The bear market itself has been milder with past downturns seeing prices plummet 77% to 85%.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $90M as BTC sits 32% below year-old ATH
description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reversed two days of inflows as Bitcoin slipped below $86,000, trading roughly 32% below its October 2025 all-time high.

title: EEZ tests atomic L1-to-L2 transaction in push to unify Ethereum
description: An EEZ contributor shared a 0.001 ETH cross-chain test as the project develops a framework to connect Ethereum mainnet and its rollups.

title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
description: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.

title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
description: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
description: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

title: Bitcoin keeps getting rejected at $87,000 as stocks hover near records
description: BTC fell back to about $85,600 after sellers turned it away from $87,000 for the third time since Sept. 23, while Nasdaq closed at a record and Treasury yields kept climbing.

title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
description: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.
